name: Income
description: Payroll, direct deposits, salaries, or incoming cash transfers

name: Work Reimbursement
description: Employer deposits that repay work expenses charged to the work credit card (SICK PROD. CENTE)

name: Credit Card Payment
description: Payments made toward credit card accounts (Amex, Chase, etc.)

name: Family Support
description: Zelle transfers to family members or relative support

name: Savings
description: Transfers into emergency funds, savings, or long-term accounts

name: Charity/Donation
description: Mosques, masjids, charities, or non-profit donations

name: Transfer
description: General online money transfers, Zelle, Venmo, or wire transfers

name: Insurance
description: Car, home, health, or life insurance (State Farm, Geico, etc.)

name: Groceries
description: Supermarkets, wholesale clubs (Sam's Club, Costco), and food markets

name: Food & Dining
description: Restaurants, cafes, coffee shops, fast food, and food delivery apps

name: Transport
description: Fuel stations (Kwik Trip, Shell, BP), public transit, rideshares, parking

name: Subscriptions
description: Digital services, streaming (Netflix, Spotify, YouTube), software, or phone bills

name: Utilities
description: Electric (Xcel Energy), internet (Quantum Fiber, Comcast), water, gas

name: Healthcare
description: Pharmacies (CVS, Walgreens), medical clinics, and dental services

name: Shopping
description: Retail stores, clothing, electronics (Amazon, Best Buy, Target)

name: Housing
description: Rent, mortgage, or home owner association (HOA) payments

name: Travel
description: Airlines, hotels, airbnbs, and travel bookings

name: Entertainment
description: Movies, concerts, events, and entertainment venues

name: Fees
description: Bank fees, interest charges, overdraft fees, or memberships

name: Personal Care
description: Hair salons, barbers, grooming, and personal care services

name: Uncategorized
description: Any transaction that does not clearly fit other categories
